Class UltraHdrWasm

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.wasm.WasmModule
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.ultrahdr.UltraHdrWasm
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public class UltraHdrWasm extends WasmModule
Low-level binding to the ultrahdr_wasm WASM module.

Each public method corresponds to one #[no_mangle] pub extern "C" export from the Rust wrapper crate. The engine executes the module via the shared WasmEngine layer (Chicory by default, GraalWasm on GraalVM).

Important: the ultrahdr codec keeps process-global state — only ONE UltraHdrWasm instance should be alive per JVM, and concurrent use must be routed through a single thread (see GainMapCodec).

This class is Closeable; always call WasmModule.close() (or use try-with-resources) to release the engine.
